Normalized all ROUGE variants to base 'ROUGE' metric according to guidelines
No LLM-as-judge evaluation used in this 2020 paper

guideline: Participants selected best/worst summaries based on Informativeness, Coherence, Grammaticality
Participants verified level of support (fully, partially, not at all) for summary sentences relative to input reviews

Participants evaluated system summaries by selecting best and worst based on Informativeness, Coherence, and Grammaticality; a second study asked raters to verify whether each summary sentence was fully, partially, or not supported by the input reviews.

Participants were asked to select the best and worst among system summaries taking into account how much they deviated from the ground truth summary in terms of: Informativeness, Coherence, and Grammaticality.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. Main changes involved normalizing metric variants (ROUGE-1/2/L/SU4 → ROUGE) and consolidating human evaluation criteria. The paper focuses on unsupervised abstractive opinion summarization with innovative denoising techniques.
